 If you've been waiting for the right time to buy the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, you're in luck. For the first time ever, Amazon is carving a straight $300 off the innovative foldable phone , no strings attached. It's unlikely that we'll see the price of the unlocked device drop much further in 2026, so why wait for Black Friday to save?

 The Galaxy Z Fold 8 sports a new book-style design with two gorgeous AMOLED displays, 12GB of RAM, and a powerful Snapdragon chip. Grab the phone from Amazon today and you'll score a straight $300 discount, marking the biggest price drop that the unlocked device has ever received.
 $300 off at Amazon 
 Expand 
 Collapse 
 The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 was unveiled earlier this year with a new look, new chipset, and a lighter design than ever before. The display design is now 4:3, which makes it perfect for gaming and streaming videos, while the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC is the same processor that powers the outstanding Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra . 
 The foldable phone's inner crease is nearly as imperceptible as Samsung claims it to be, plus the inner display's anti-reflective coating ensures that you can use the Z Fold 8 in any light. The phone also boasts a 4,800mAh battery with ultra-fast 45W charging, and you'll get to enjoy all of the latest software features from Galaxy AI straight out of the box. 
 Like most modern Samsung phones , the Z Fold 8 guarantees seven years of OS and security upgrades, and with a retail price of $1,900, the eye-catching foldable is $200 cheaper than the new Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra. 
 So what's the catch?
 Well, surely I don't need to tell you that, even with this discount, $1,500 is a lot for a smartphone. In fact, the price is the main problem that I have the Galaxy Z Fold 8, so if you can get past that issue, then you're golden.
 If the unlocked phone is still too pricey for you, it's worth mentioning that quite a few wireless carriers are running deals that heavily discount the Galaxy Z Fold 8 when you process a trade-in or add a new line to your wireless account. T-Mobile, for example, is currently slashing $1,200 off the Z Fold 8 when you add a line with the Experience More or Experience Beyond plan. 
 In addition to the steep price tag, the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 does have a few limitations that you should be aware of before you take the leap. The cameras are only serviceable, which is a bit disappointing when you consider the price of the phone, plus you don't get IP68 water-and-dust resistance. 
 All in all, these are small issues when you consider the overall package that is the Galaxy Z Fold 8. The phone is one of the best foldable devices that Samsung has ever built, and with this early Black Friday deal from Amazon, it just became a little more accessible.
